title: 腾讯文档授权
description: 输入腾讯文档个人 MCP Token：电脑端打开腾讯文档空间列表（docs.qq.com），点进一个空间，点右上角「≡」→「使用MCP」→「获取MCP token」→「复制」。Token 按空间生成、有效期一年，仅加密保存在本机。获取资格与每日配额以官方页面实时校验为准（官方文档提示需通过超级会员/Plus 校验）。Token 失效或泄露时，在同一菜单「重置」后重新填写。
description_en: Enter your Tencent Docs personal MCP token: on desktop, open your Tencent Docs space list (docs.qq.com), enter a space, click the "≡" menu in the top-right corner, choose "Use MCP" → "Get MCP token" → "Copy". The token is generated per space, valid for one year, and stored locally (encrypted) only. Eligibility and daily quota are subject to on-page verification (official docs mention a Super VIP/Plus check). If the token expires or leaks, reset it in the same menu and update it here.
